/bin/bash -c "python - <<'PY'
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
import numpy as np
x=np.load('source_pixels.npz')['rgb']
# car crop, enlarged 4x for frames 0-47 and 48-95
for chunk in range(2):
    ids=list(range(chunk*48,(chunk+1)*48))
    cw,ch=90,55
    sheet=Image.new('RGB',(cw*4*6, (ch*4+20)*8),(20,22,26))
    d=ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
    for j,i in enumerate(ids):
        crop=Image.fromarray(x[i,75:130,0:110]).resize((440,220),Image.Resampling.NEAREST)
        x0=(j%6)*440;y0=(j//6)*240
        d.text((x0+4,y0+2),f'{i:02d} / {i/24:.2f}s',fill='white')
        sheet.paste(crop,(x0,y0+20))
    sheet.save(f'.tmp/cars_{chunk}.png')
PY"
